PSALM 98

. In view of the wonders of grace and righteousness displayed in God's salvation, the whole creation is invited to unite in praise.

1. gotten ... victory--literally, "made salvation," enabled Him to save His people.

right hand, and ... arm--denote power.

holy arm--or, "arm of holiness," the power of His united moral perfections (; ).
2. salvation--the result of His righteousness (; ), and both are publicly displayed.
3. The union of mercy and truth (; ) secure the blessings of the promise (; ) to all the world (Is 52:10).

4-6. make a loud noise--or, "burst forth" (; 44:23).

before ... King--hail Him as your sovereign; and while, with every aid to demonstrate zeal and joy, intelligent creatures are invited to praise, as in , inanimate nature is also summoned to honor Him who triumphs and rules in righteousness and equity.
